value.rationale: The original 2023 study left broad hypergraph suppression without analytical bounds. An infinite class of nonsymmetric, possibly mixed-edge-size networks now has a rigorous strictly suppressing result for all non-neutral fitnesses and each initial condition. Contrasts with Moran equality for degree-regular pairwise updates. Not a mere parameter substitution because group-size-driven positive drift is the essential new mechanism.
